COPYRIGHT WARNING: OVER. 
S/231564 COPYRIGHT UNDERWOOD & UDERWOOD, N.Y. 
PROMINENT SUPPERAGE POLETS SAY THEY ARE BEING 
ILL-TRIED IN PRISON.

A number of infrage pickers were sued again in Washington when they started to pick the White House in force. The suits in prison are not having a pleasant time of it according to the reports which they are circulating of the treatment they're receiving.

Miss Lucy Burns, who is in Occoquer Jail, was forced to throw a shoe through a window to get air, and declares she has been bruitally and inhumanly treated. The photograph was taken after the women had been released from prison a short time ago and shows them in their prison gurb.
